structured.answer: A keren hishtalmut is savings from the salary where I put 2.5% and the employer adds 7.5%, and after 6 years (3 for studies) I can take it out without tax — so I think it's worth having for the employer's money, but it is invested, not a deposit, and I'll ask my son or the bank which safe option to choose.

stuck.why: Many numbers and colours; red '−13,974' with striped bar scared me; had to match numbers to coloured bars back and forth
S&P 500 and מדד made me feel it is about shares, not safe saving
'המדינה לא ערבה לשווי הקרן' worried me; stopped soon after

used: 'מה זה' paragraphs: 6 years, 3 years for studies, tax before 6 years
Fees table: דמי ניהול עד 2% בשנה, no exit fee
Warning box 'משיכה לפני הזמן אפשרית, אבל יקרה'
skimmed: Calculator input boxes and bar charts
not_found: Plain statement of which investment option is safe like a deposit
Clear yes/no on whether it is worth joining
Whether the money can lose value in a simple sentence near the top

findings.what: Red minus number and striped bar in the chart frighten and push me away
Busy screen full of numbers and close colours; numbers written above bars, have to match back and forth
Small pale grey text on dark background unreadable
findings.where: Notes under chart, screen 2; footnotes throughout

findings.what: English letters and 'מדד' in investment options right on first screen
Same 'חוקים וכללים · N' tag repeated on every block, read it again each time
Dark background overall hard on the eyes
Technical words not explained in place (ריאלי, ותק, הפקדה מוטבת)
No simple sentence saying it is not guaranteed like a deposit until far down
